pulls.title: 8391431: RISC-V: AOTCodeTest.java fails after JDK-8388288 with fastdebug
pulls.author: zifeihan
pulls.activity: 新建、2 个 Review、5 条评论
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, I ran `make test TEST="runtime/cds/appcds/aotCode/AOTCodeTest.java#g1"` on RISC-V K3 with fastdebug model, and the test failed. In stubGenerator_riscv.cpp, verify_oop_array uses t0 to hold the loop bound computed once before the loop: ``` __ mv(t1, zr); __ slli(t0, count, exact_log2(size)); __ bind(loop); __ bgeu(t1, t0, end); ``` In PR https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/pull/31923, a UseZicond branch was added, which clobbers t0 here, causing the test to fail. https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/blob/7353d1725b93d6caade70440f177e07178d48906/src/hotspot/cpu/riscv/macroAssembler_riscv.cpp#L4069-L408

pulls.author: egahlin
pulls.body_excerpt: Could I have a review of a PR that makes the `jfr assemble` command work against unfinished files? **Problem** Users copy chunk files from the JFR repository while the JVM is running. pulls.title: 8390604: Speed up native --> Java transitions
pulls.author: dean-long
pulls.body_excerpt: After JDK-8390603 and related cleanups, we no longer have transition states or the need for an intermediate state when changing thread states. The last remaining transition that needs cleanup is natve --> Java, which after JDK-8390603 does _thread_in_native --> _thread_in_vm --> _thread_in_Java. Instead the fast path can go directly from _thread_in_native to _thread_in_Java. However, if we need to take the slow path and process a safepoint, we will still transition to _thread_in_vm during that time. pulls.title: 8389968: (dc) DatagramChannel.open() attempts to disable IPPROTO_IPV6/IP_MULTICAST_ALL (lnx)
pulls.author: AlanBateman
pulls.body_excerpt: On Linux, DatagramChannel needs to enables the per-socket membership filter so that it doesn't receive multicast datagrams sent to any group that has been joined on the host. When the socket is IPv4 then it should disable IPPROTO_IP/IP_MULTICAST_ALL. When the socket is IPv6 then it should disable IPPROTO_IPV6/IPV6_MULTICAST_ALL, and additionally disable IPPROTO_IP/IP_MULTICAST_ALL when the system has IPv4 enabled too. pulls.title: 8388329: [lworld] Forward variable access in strict initializers bypass DA
pulls.author: mcimadamore
pulls.body_excerpt: The new rules that allow field reads from early construction context rely on the fact that access to uninitialized fields will be caught by either DA/DU analysis (JLS chapter 16), or by forward-reference logic (JLS 8.3.3). Unfortunately these two sections have different ideas on what needs to be checked: * DA/DU only concerns with _blank_ final final fields. Moreover, it doesn't track things like `T.this.x`. pulls.title: 8380847: Versioned class loaded from multi-release jar file is not cached
pulls.author: matias9927
pulls.body_excerpt: When performing an AOT training run using a multi-release JAR file, the following warning can be encountered: `[warning][aot] class org/example/Foo cannot be archived because it was not defined from <path to mr.jar> as claimed` This warning results from a specific configuration of the JAR file where the class is not in the root directory but is present in the versioned directory `META-INF/version`.
